failure_target: next-minute aggregate entry-service trace 5xx rate meets threshold
prediction_task: failure state, including ongoing failures; not onset-only forecasting
root_cause_target: high-confidence proxy: the unique reliable injected service active at failure-event onset; the event root is repeated across its failed minutes and temporal overlap does not prove causation

root_event_protocol.evaluation_unit: failure event; aggregate window scores within an event before ranking

entry_service_limitation: webservice1/2 are an entry-service approximation; top-level request identity is not verified
missing_policy: entry_observed=0 excludes the target from training; unknown roots are masked
